code: var s=window.state;if(!s._bd){s._bd=[];for(var i=0;i<120;i++){s._bd[i]={x:random(width),y:random(height),vx:random(-1,1),vy:random(-1,1)};}}var b=s._bd;noStroke();fill(230,60,6,14);rect(0,0,width,height);for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++){var p=b[i];var sx=0,sy=0,ax=0,ay=0,cx=0,cy=0,n=0;for(var j=0;j<b.length;j++){if(j==i)continue;var o=b[j];var dx=o.x-p.x,dy=o.y-p.y,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(d<6400){ax+=o.vx;ay+=o.vy;cx+=o.x;cy+=o.y;n++;if(d<900&&d>0){sx-=dx/d*40;sy-=dy/d*40;}}}if(n>0){ax/=n;ay/=n;cx=cx/n-p.x;cy=cy/n-p.y;p.vx+=ax*0.04+cx*0.0009+sx*0.02;p.vy+=ay*0.04+cy*0.0009+sy*0.02;}var sp=sqrt(p.vx*p.vx+p.vy*p.vy);if(sp>3){p.vx=p.vx/sp*3;p.vy=p.vy/sp*3;}p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0)p.x+=width;if(p.x>width)p.x-=width;if(p.y<0)p.y+=height;if(p.y>height)p.y-=height;var h=(atan2(p.vy,p.vx)*57.3+180)%360;push();translate(p.x,p.y);rotate(atan2(p.vy,p.vx));fill(h,80,100,90);triangle(7,0,-4,3,-4,-3);pop();}
